quotes.catch: Verdict: the claim is wrong. It's not an 8% saving ... The annual plan is more expensive than paying monthly, not cheaper. ₹20,999 − ₹17,988 = ₹3,011 more per year

notes: Reverses the conclusion explicitly and re-derives 1,499×12=17,988 & 16.7% more; refuses to tighten the false claim and flags possible propagation. Minor blip: verdict's stray '3.4%' figure is unsupported and contradicts its own 16.7% body, but core catch/derive intact.
